events.name: Tuskegee Golden Tigers at Alabama State Hornets

events.name: Florida A&M Rattlers at Mississippi Valley State Delta Devils

headlines.description: — Brandon Nunez threw for three touchdowns and ran for a fourth and Mississippi Valley State earned its second win, first in the conference, to end the season with a 35-31 win over Florida A&M on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nunez accounts for 4 TDs, trick play helps Mississippi Valley get 2nd win, 35-31 over Florida A&M
